route.alt: Map of the available motorcycle tracks from Seattle to Kalaloch, a loop on the Olympic Peninsula, and the return to Seattle.

photos.alt: Rows of motorcycles parked on a ferry deck beneath a blue sky.
The Seattle skyline and Space Needle seen through ferry cabin windows.
A narrow gravel road with a grassy center winding through dense green forest.
Two campers wearing headlamps among tall trees at night, one wrapped in a blue blanket patterned with bananas.
A view through a tent doorway toward campers and a picnic table beneath tall forest trees.
A person in a gray hoodie leaning over a motorcycle beside tents, a picnic table, and a pickup truck at a forest campsite.
A wooden-railed path descending to a quiet paved road surrounded by forest.
A helmeted rider standing on an old bridge, with two motorcycles parked by the forest road behind.
Heavy weathered wooden beams and diagonal braces supporting a bridge above ferns and leafy undergrowth.
Tall moss-covered trees surrounded by dense ferns and leafy undergrowth.
Three distant figures on a broad beach beneath thick fog and breaking waves.
A wooden boardwalk leading past large trees and ferns in a shaded forest.
Driftwood on a wide sandy beach beside a forested bluff fading into coastal mist.
A dense cluster of gooseneck barnacles with pale shells and dark stalks.
Seaweed-covered rocks and shallow water along the base of a rocky coastal bluff.
A shallow tide pool filled with green sea anemones and dark seaweed between rocks.
Green sea anemones with open tentacles beneath clear tide-pool water.
A broad sandy beach and forested coastal bluff seen between foreground rocks in the mist.
Layered shoreline rocks and tide pools extending toward waves and an offshore sea stack.
Large tilted rock formations rising from pale sand beside a forested bluff.
A small crab on wet sand with coastal rocks softly blurred behind it.
A long wooden dock extending into Hood Canal beside a wooded shoreline beneath blue sky.
Calm Hood Canal water and a pebbly beach below distant wooded hills and scattered clouds.
A helmeted rider standing beside a motorcycle in the boarding queue at a ferry terminal.
Evening sunlight breaking through clouds over the water outside a ferry cabin window.
